parsed.name: 通用蓝牙流式采集设备
parsed.description: 一种通用的蓝牙传感器或采集设备，可连续向实验计算机发送测量数据，并作为 LSL 数据流用于同步记录、在线监测和联合实验。适用于生理信号、运动信号或其他实时传感数据的采集。
parsed.description_en: A generic Bluetooth sensor or acquisition device that continuously sends measurement data to a lab computer and publishes it as an LSL stream for synchronized recording, online monitoring, and multimodal experiments. It is suitable for acquiring biosignals, motion signals, or other real-time sensor data.
